name: lamset-fan-business-manager
description: LAMSET FAN Business Manager Android app

scripts.build:android: npx esbuild www/mobile-bridge.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=www/mobile-bridge.bundle.js && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.check:all: npm run check:inline-js && node --check www/mobile-bridge.js && node scripts/check-catalog-export.cjs && node scripts/check-order-validation.cjs && node scripts/check-order-post-save.cjs && node scripts/check-order-status-consistency.cjs && node scripts/check-order-production-consistency.cjs && node scripts/check-customer-linking.cjs
